name: flin-gtm-mcp
description: Read-only Google Tag Manager: inspect accounts, containers, tags, triggers and versions.

client_id.title: OAuth client ID
client_id.description: Google OAuth Desktop app client ID. Enable the Tag Manager API in that Google Cloud project.

client_secret.title: OAuth client secret
client_secret.description: Secret belonging to the same Google OAuth Desktop app client.

long_description: Read-only Google Tag Manager access. Enter your Google Desktop app OAuth client ID and client secret, then request Google authentication. Downloads the newest stable flin-gtm-mcp server from PyPI whenever the extension starts. Updates need internet and take effect after a server/Claude restart. Google credentials and login stay on this Mac.
